body.zh: 新华、gov.cn、日喀则简报与@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus至10月3日无新吉隆伤亡帖。中方仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。外交9月24日仍称261名外籍失联。NDRRMA无新SitRep分项；10月1日已转恢复并核查失联。堰塞湖已排空。口岸关闭。G216至9月20日仍管制。勿与中方相加。
body.en: No new Gyirong casualty post from Xinhua, gov.cn, Shigatse briefings, @XHNews or @CCTV_Plus through 3 Oct. CN remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. MFA 24 Sep still 261 foreign missing. No new NDRRMA split; 1 Oct recovery and missing verification. Lake drained. Gate closed. G216 still controlled as of 20 Sep. Do not add CN.
body.ne: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus 3 Oct samma naya casualty chaina. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MFA 24 Sep 261 foreign. NDRRMA naya split chaina; 1 Oct recovery. Tal khali. Gate band. G216 20 Sep niyantran. CN najodnu.
body.hi: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus 3 Oct tak naya casualty nahi. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MFA 24 Sep 261 videshi. NDRRMA naya split nahi; 1 Oct recovery. Jheel khali. Gate band. G216 20 Sep niyantran. CN na joden.
